{{Top}}
A '''diagnostic scanner''' was a type of [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] that was designed to diagnose problems. They were commonly installed on [[Droid/Legends|droids]],<ref name="NEGTD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> such as [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droids]]<ref name="DSTC">''[[Death Star Technical Companion]]''</ref> and [[Medical droid/Legends|medical droids]].<ref name="NEGTD" /> Diagnostic scanners were also included in [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] such as [[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[GLiS Emergency Medpac]] were they were capable of monitoring a patient's vital signs.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
